versions.sourceTitle: Guia do Jogador V5, PDF pp. 82

pt-BR.title: Descrição
pt-BR.text: Faz a voz surgir de qualquer ponto à vista, como sussurro ou grito. Pode deixá-la num local, atraindo ou aterrorizando quem se aproxime conforme o poder associado.

pt-BR.title: Sistema
pt-BR.text: Nenhum teste além do Teste de Sangue. Com Voz Irresistível, Melpominee ou poderes semelhantes, faça os testes desses poderes normalmente. A voz soa como se o vampiro estivesse no ponto escolhido, e seu alcance depende do volume.

en.title: Description
en.text: Amalgam: Auspex 1 The vampire can cause their voice to emanate from any point within sight, whether as a whisper or shout. The voice is audible as if the vampire was standing in that spot and can be heard by anyone within earshot, depending on strength. The voice can also be left in a location, continuing to lure or terrify those who stray, depending on the power used.

en.title: Cost
en.text:
One Rouse Check

 Dice Pools: N/A

en.title: System
en.text: No roll is required, apart from the Rouse Check. If using this power in combination with Irresistible Voice, Melpominee, or similar powers, they must roll as usual.
